clauses.quote: The total amount will be determined in negotiations
The total amount will be allocated to the schools on an as-need basis.
At the elementary level, principals will use allocated funds to hire part-time teacher aides (if available) to assist in lunch-time supervisory duties.
If no aides can be hired for this purpose, teachers who agree to perform the duties otherwise assigned to the aides will be compensated at the Secondary Lunch Monitor rate (Classified Lane dd)
clauses.subject_text: teachers who agree to perform the duties otherwise assigned to the aides

clauses.quote: At the secondary level, teachers who agree to perform extra lunch-time duties in order to reduce lunch-time duties for other teachers will be compensated at the Secondary Lunch Monitor rate (Classified Lane dd).
clauses.subject_text: teachers who agree to perform extra lunch-time duties in order to reduce lunch-time duties for other teachers

clauses.quote: Normally, secondary teachers will spend preparation and consultation periods at the school.

However, teachers may on occasion be excused by the principal, or the principal's designee, to utilize other facilities for school-related professional purposes to aid the teacher in meeting the needs of students.

the regularly assigned teacher, under guidelines formulated by the staff and approved by the principal, may leave the classroom and use that time as a preparation period, or for other professional purposes.
Only in case of emergency will teachers be required to serve as substitutes.
Insofar as administratively possible, such emergency substituting assignments will be distributed among all faculty members.

In the event that a substitute teacher is not provided for a contract teacher who has requested a substitute for a sick personal or sick family day prior to 6:30 a.m., the absence will result in a “failed-to-fill.”
In such situations, when contract teachers are asked to cover the failed-to-fill, they shall be paid a prorated share of the Level V substitute teacher rate.
Secondary teachers who cover the failed-to-fill during what would have been their paid consultation period will coordinate with their supervisor to fulfill the contractual obligation.
clauses.subject_text: Secondary teachers who cover the failed-to-fill during what would have been their paid consultation period

clauses.quote: The teaching load for secondary teachers shall not exceed six teaching periods a day.
clauses.subject_text: The teaching load for secondary teachers

clauses.quote: The normal teaching assignment for secondary teachers is not more than three teaching preparations and not more than two subject areas.
clauses.subject_text: The normal teaching assignment for secondary teachers
clauses.notes: Establishes maximums for preparation and subject areas.
